summary_claims.claim: Art. 12 inserts Art. 437-bis into the Criminal Code, one to five years where danger to life or public or individual safety results. Literal translation: 'is punished with imprisonment of one to five years, when danger to life or to public or individual safety results from such omissions.'
Art. 18: causation between a breach of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 and the damage is presumed unless proved otherwise; Art. 20(2): injured party has a direct action against the insurer
